policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="agentName" value="@{
        var segments = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path.Trim('/').Split('/');
        for (var i = 0; i < segments.Length - 1; i++)
        {
            if (string.Equals(segments[i], "agents", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return segments[i + 1];
            }
        }
        return string.Empty;
    }" />
    
      
        
        
      
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          {"error":"Missing agent name in path. Expected route containing /agents/{agentName}."}
